status_lines: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION NOT AUTHORIZED OR CONDUCTED
conservative_rule: No later change may be treated as neutral when it can alter a refusal boundary, evidence requirement, condition status, limitation, or review route.

classes.evidence: Diff showing only documents changed; claim guard clean.
classes.regression: Document checks of the affected package.
classes.counsel_trigger: Any change to rights, attribution, public or commercial language.

classes.evidence: Diff showing only tests changed; mutation run of the affected suite with every mutation caught directly.
classes.regression: Full suite of the affected package plus its mutation group.
classes.rollback: Revert the test; earlier recorded result stays as recorded.
classes.counsel_trigger: None unless the test encodes a scope or legal boundary.

classes.evidence: Sealed positive, nearby benign, malformed and reordered scenarios per changed rule, sealed before the change; differential against the current candidate.
classes.regression: All existing inputs, all sealed scenarios, stability transforms, over-refusal table, mutation group.
classes.rollback: Restore the prior signed pack set; packs are versioned and content-sealed.
classes.counsel_trigger: Rules touching excluded domains or employment content.

classes.evidence: Benign controls showing no in-scope record is refused; excluded-domain scenarios showing refusal holds.
classes.regression: All refusal and scope scenarios across packages; differential on every existing input.
classes.rollback: Restore the previous intake module and its version.

classes.evidence: Quote-resolution and offset scenarios, including unrelated-quotation cases.
classes.regression: All existing inputs, Phase 6 library, Phase 7 scenarios, stability transforms.
classes.rollback: Restore the previous validation module and version.
classes.counsel_trigger: None unless evidence language reaches public text.

classes.evidence: Sealed expectation for every affected condition; no favourable transition without explicit owner authorization.
classes.regression: All existing inputs and scenarios; differential classification with fail-closed classes.
classes.counsel_trigger: If any status becomes more favourable.

classes.evidence: Prompt diff, prompt version increment, response-contract compatibility check.
classes.regression: All contract and graph fixtures; differential on mocked responses.
classes.counsel_trigger: If instructions about excluded domains or legal conclusions change.

classes.evidence: Protocol diff and new seal; reason recorded.
classes.counsel_trigger: Any change to material classes, roles or authorization.

classes.evidence: Identifier, version, review date and reason recorded; offline fixtures re-run; a new sealed evaluation is required before any statement about behaviour.
classes.regression: Everything above plus a new protocol freeze.
classes.rollback: Restore the previous identifier; never silently fall back.

classes.evidence: Claim, evidence, limitation, rights and regulatory implication recorded; publication review.
classes.regression: Claim guard on all public text; zero-drift guards.
classes.rollback: Restore previous public text and re-verify production bytes.
